slug: 2024-11-04 Cameroon's Campost partners with FindMe to improve national address system

facts.fact: Business in Cameroon reports Campost signed a partnership with FindMe on 1 November 2024 in Yaounde to enhance the national address system.
Business in Cameroon reports FindMe's postal-addressing model, already deployed in Senegal, has been operational in Cameroon since July 2024.
